name: Shanghai
intro: A fast-paced coastal metropolis blending historic neighbourhoods, waterfront views, contemporary architecture and food culture.

name: Beijing
intro: China’s capital offers imperial history, major museums, traditional neighbourhoods and access to iconic sections of the Great Wall.

name: Guangzhou
intro: A southern city known for Cantonese food, Lingnan heritage, riverfront landmarks and lively neighbourhood districts.

name: Shenzhen
intro: A modern city with creative districts, technology markets, parks, waterfront spaces and easy access to contemporary urban experiences.

name: Chengdu
intro: A relaxed Sichuan destination associated with panda experiences, teahouse culture, local food and historic neighbourhoods.

name: Chongqing
intro: A dramatic mountain city shaped by rivers, layered streets, skyline viewpoints and distinctive local cuisine.

name: Harbin
intro: A northeastern city with distinctive historic architecture and a famous winter season of ice and snow attractions.

name: Xinjiang
intro: A vast region with diverse landscapes, long-distance journeys, mountain scenery, historic cities and rich cultural experiences.

name: Xi’an
intro: A historic capital where Qin, Han and Tang-era heritage meets lively food streets, city walls, night-time cultural districts and regional opera. Beyond the major monuments, explore Shaanxi food traditions and neighbourhood lanes.
